title: Loyalty and Subscription Strategies Manager
description:
Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!

Location: 100% on site - Vila Olimpia, SP

Please upload an English version of your resume.


About the Position

We are looking for a strategic and creative professional to lead our Gamification & Subscription Strategies efforts. This role focuses on building innovative mechanisms such as missions, streaks, and loyalty programs that drive user engagement, as well as developing subscription-based models that strengthen recurrence and create long-term value. You will design, test, and scale programs that make our platform fun, sticky, and habit-forming, positioning us to compete head-to-head with established loyalty schemes in the market.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement gamification strategies (progress bars, streaks, missions, rewards) that increase frequency and stickiness across user segments.
  • Develop and refine subscription models and loyalty programs that maximize user retention and LTV, while differentiating from competitor offerings.
  • Collaborate with CRM, Growth, and Product teams to integrate gamification mechanics into the user journey and app experience.
  • Conduct A/B testing and experimentation to evaluate the impact of gamified features and subscription perks on user behavior.
  • Monitor and analyze engagement metrics, progression funnel, and churn patterns to optimize program design and efficiency.
  • Partner with Data and Finance teams to build business cases for gamification and subscription initiatives, measuring ROI and long-term sustainability.
  • Explore partnerships with restaurants, brands, and third parties to enrich the subscription and gamification ecosystem.
  • Stay ahead of market trends and competitor strategies, ensuring our programs are locally relevant, innovative, and scalable.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in business, economics, engineering, or related fields.
  • Robust experience in user operations, loyalty, CRM, or product growth strategy in digital platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills, with proficiency in SQL, Python, or other tools to extract insights and validate impact.
  • Demonstrated experience in designing and scaling gamification or subscription programs.
  • Familiarity with user segmentation, behavioral psychology, and habit-forming product design.
  • Background in e-commerce, O2O, food delivery, or subscription-based businesses preferred.
  • Strong project management and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Creative, data-driven, and results-oriented, with the ability to balance user delight with business impact.


We hope to see you soon ;)


#Keeta #EatBetter #Live Better

title: Analista de Inteligência de Mercado Sênior – Estratégia e Precificação
description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra. Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 140 centros de distribuição, /o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos. Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.


O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Analista apaixonada por diversidade, tecnologia e temas de recrutamento, com experiência em conduzir processos seletivos de ponta a ponta, especialmente em ambientes com alto volume de vagas e perfis variados.



Analista de Inteligência de Mercado Sênior – Estratégia e Precificação


Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Inteligência de Mercado Sênior com foco em estratégia de preços para integrar nosso time.

Este profissional será responsável por analisar tendências, monitorar concorrência e desenvolver estratégias que garantam competitividade e rentabilidade, apoiando decisões estratégicas da empresa.


Modelo de Trabalho: Híbrido – presencial 3 vezes por semana na cidade de Boituva/SP .


Principais Atividades:

  • Desenvolver análises de mercado e estudos de precificação para diferentes linhas de produtos.
  • Monitorar concorrentes, tendências de mercado e indicadores econômicos que impactem preços.
  • Elaborar relatórios e dashboards com insights estratégicos para áreas comerciais e executivas.
  • Apoiar na definição de políticas de preços e estratégias de posicionamento.
  • Realizar simulações de cenários e análises de elasticidade de preços.
  • Garantir a integração das informações de mercado com áreas de planejamento, marketing e vendas.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Estatística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em inteligência de mercado e precificação.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de análise de dados (Excel avançado, Power BI, ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de preços e análise de elasticidade.
  • Perfil analítico, visão estratégica e habilidade para trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados.

Benefícios:

  • Assistência médica e odontológica estendida a dependentes;
  • Seguro de vida;

  • Vale-refeição;

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Sênior
description:

Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 140 centros de distribuição, /o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos. Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade

Responsabilidades


  • Implementar, testar e participar processos de Recuperação de Desastres, visando a manutenção dos serviços da empresa.
  • Implementar princípios de projeto Seguro em arquiteturas de rede (TCP/IP, WI-FI, SDN, protocolos de convergência), visando o funcionamento seguro após implementação.
  • Auditar e controlar o processo de gestão de acessos, garantindo conformidade nos acessos bem como ciclo de vida e identidade.
  • Controlar o gerenciamento de identificação, autorização dos acessos lógicos de pessoas, dispositivos e serviços, visando bloqueios de acesso e manutenção de segurança.
  • Projetar e validar estratégias de avaliação, teste e auditoria, verificando se os controles de Segurança da Informação estão de acordo com as normas e políticas de segurança da informação estabelecidas.
  • Conduzir testes de controle de segurança por meio da avaliação e gestão de vulnerabilidades, penetração, códigos e interface.
  • Conduzir toda e qualquer investigação digital junto com as áreas de Compliance e Segurança Empresarial, provendo apoio computacional, bem como fornecendo procedimentos e assessoria em processos de perícia forense.



Requisitos


  • Ensino superior completo em: Ciência da Computação, Análise de Sistemas, Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da informação, Sistemas da Informação e/ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Conhecimento em: Processo de resposta a incidentes / CSIRTs; Proteção e privacidade da informação;
  • Melhores práticas de mercado Cobit, ITIL, ISO 27000, OWASP, NIST, CIS; Gerenciamento de patch e vulnerabilidade; Testes de controle de segurança (Testes de penetração, Avaliação de vulnerabilidades, Revisão e testes de código);
  • Atuação com implementação ou administração de soluções de segurança para infraestrutura de redes (Firewall, IDP/IPS, DLP, WAF, ANTIDDOS, AntiSpam, Filtro de conteúdo);
  • Atuação com implementação ou administração de soluções de segurança para estações de trabalho (AV, AntiMalware, DLP, Criptografia de disco).



Benefícios:

  • Wellhub;

title: Pessoa Especialista de Governança de Identidades - IAM / IGA
description:
Sobre a vaga

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.



Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.



O DESAFIO

Estamos procurando uma pessoa para fazer parte do nosso time Segurança da Informação aqui na Dimensa. É uma vaga hibrida, 3X por semana no nosso escritório da Av Braz Leme em São Paulo.

Você será responsável por garantir a segurança, conformidade e eficiência na gestão de identidades e acessos através da implementação, operação e evolução contínua de soluções IAM/IGA.


O QUE PRECISA

  • Administrar e evoluir as soluções de IAM/IGA com foco em Horacius E-Trust, Google Identity e Keycloak.
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida de identidades (provisionamento, alteração e desprovisionamento).
  • Definir e aplicar políticas de acesso baseadas em perfil, função e risco.
  • Garantir conformidade com normas de segurança e auditoria de acessos.
  • Realizar integrações entre sistemas internos e plataformas de autenticação/autorização.
  • Monitorar e responder a incidentes relacionados à identidade digital.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas com evidências e relatórios de acessos.
  • Conduzir revisões periódicas de acessos e certificações de identidade.
  • Documentar processos, fluxos e regras de negócio relacionados à governança de identidades.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para temas de IAM/IGA na empresa.
  • Ensino Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas.


DIFERENCIAL

  • Administração e integração de Horacius E-Trust
  • Gestão de identidades com Google Identity e Keycloak
  • Protocolos de autenticação: SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect
  • Conceitos de RBAC, ABAC e políticas de acesso
  • Ferramentas de auditoria e logging de acesso
  • Integrações via API/REST para automação de provisionamento
  • Segurança da informação e gestão de riscos
  • Conhecimento em frameworks como NIST, ISO 27001, LGPD
  • Certificações em soluções específicas (Horacius E-Trust, Google Cloud Identity, Keycloak ou aplicações correlatas)
  • Certificações em segurança da informação (CompTIA Security+, ISO 27001, ou similares)
  • Certificações de algum provedor de núvem pública: AWS, GCP ou Azure
  • Obrigatório: Curso ou experiência comprovada em implantação de algum IAM/IGA



O QUE OFERECEMOS:


️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Business Development Executive
description:
About us:

Esco Lifesciences Group is improving lives through science! Headquartered in Singapore, expanded globally with factories and offices in 43 locations around the world, Esco is building a synergistic ecosystem of life science tools, diagnostics, therapies, and technologies to improve human lives.

With nearly 50 years of history and a strong foundation in Singapore, Esco is a dynamic, fast-growing, mid-sized multinational organization that bridges East and West. We offer a diverse, inclusive, and globally connected environment where you’ll collaborate with top experts and visionary clients worldwide. As we accelerate our global expansion, you’ll have the unique opportunity to grow your career in tandem with the company, driving innovation and shaping a healthier, more equitable, and resilient future.


Job Overview:

We are seeking a results-driven and experienced Business Development Executive to drive the growth of our business within the dynamic Life Sciences sector. You will be responsible for identifying, qualifying, and securing new strategic partnerships and client relationships. You will own the entire sales cycle for a defined territory or portfolio, directly contributing to our company's market leadership and revenue targets.


Job title: Business Development Executive

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute targeted growth strategies aligned with the company's global business objectives for the assigned territory(Brazil&Latin America markets).
  • Conduct continuous market analysis (across Healthcare, Research, Industrial, and Education sectors) to identify new opportunities and monitor competitor activities.
  • Build, sustain, and expand a robust network of sales and distribution channels.
  • Conduct comprehensive sales and product training for distributors to ensure market readiness and effectiveness.
  • Manage and develop channel partner relationships through regular performance reviews, joint business planning, and frequent meetings.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to support operational processes, review performance, and implement necessary improvements.
  • Plan and execute end-user awareness initiatives, including seminars, webinars, exhibitions, and targeted email campaigns.
  • Lead the launch of new products by building and executing pre-defined commercial strategies.
  • Implement targeted measures to enhance sales effectiveness and efficiency.
  • Prepare and submit detailed monthly sales and marketing reports.
  • Fulfill any other related duties as assigned to support the broader commercial team.


Key Requirements:

  • Degree/Diploma in Science or Engineering or other relevant fields
  • Experience in sales of laboratory equipment preferred but not mandatory
  • Laboratory experience including working with standard equipment such a biosafety cabinet, incubator, fume hoods etc will be a plus
  • At least 8 years+ of relevant sales experience in the life science industry
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and presentation skills
  • Able to work independently in fast-paced work environment
  • Able to work long hours when required to accommodate communication with stakeholders from different time zones
  • Self-driven, results-oriented and able to work well under pressure
  • Good communication level in Spanish and English is required.

title: Analista de Performance em Marketplaces
description:
1. SOBRE NÓS

A ZAWA é uma empresa em constante crescimento, com mais de oito anos de atuação no setor de importação e e-commerce. Com sede administrativa em Curitiba/PR, e operação logística em Joinville/SC, atuamos nos principais marketplaces focando em qualidade, eficiência operacional e na excelência do atendimento ao cliente.

Acreditamos que resultados sustentáveis nascem da autorresponsabilidade e da dedicação ao essencial. Nossa cultura é pautada na autonomia, colaboração, organização e praticidade. Por isso, nossos princípios se concentram em:

  • Essencialismo: Priorizamos o que gera valor. Evitamos excesso de processos e mantemos ambientes físicos e digitais organizados e funcionais.
  • Responsabilidade individual: Esperamos que cada colaborador assuma o protagonismo da própria evolução, com consciência e compromisso.
  • Capricho e qualidade: A atenção aos detalhes é fundamental para nosso padrão de excelência. Prezamos entregas bem executadas, com precisão e zelo.
  • Aprendizado contínuo: Incentivamos a busca ativa por conhecimento. Entendemos que aprender e aprimorar são necessidades constantes.
  • Ambiente saudável : Preservamos o bom convívio coletivo através de relações leves, respeitosas e emocionalmente equilibradas.
  • Mentalidade orientada à solução: Além de identificar problemas e desafios, nossos profissionais buscam soluções viáveis, traduzindo ideias em planos de ação.
  • Resultado com propósito: Esforço sem resultado não é virtude — é ineficiência. Valorizamos resultados concretos que impactam diretamente em nossos objetivos.

Na ZAWA, oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho que valoriza a independência, com liberdade para autogestão do tempo e alta perspectiva de crescimento. Operamos com processos enxutos e eficientes, em uma estrutura organizacional compacta (equipe de 5 a 10 pessoas). Buscamos profissionais que compartilhem dos mesmos valores e queiram evoluir junto à empresa, contribuindo com consistência, visão e responsabilidade.


2. INFORMAÇÕES DA VAGA

Cargo: Analista de performance em marketplaces (Cargo Operacional de Inteligência)

Palavras-chave: Gestor / Analista / Performance / Vendas / Marketplace

Local: Sede administrativa – Rebouças, Curitiba/PR

Tipo de contratação: PJ - Híbrido

  • Home-office com uma reunião presencial por semana.

Remuneração: R$ 4.000,00

Bonificação por desempenho: R$ 4.000,00/trimestre

* Média Salarial com atingimento de metas: R$ 5.333,33


3. ATRIBUIÇÕES

O Analista de Performance em Marketplaces irá atuar de forma estratégica e operacional, com foco em atingir metas de vendas e maximizar o lucro nos principais marketplaces do país. O profissional será responsável por monitorar dados de desempenho diariamente, identificar gargalos e propor soluções ágeis e eficazes, garantindo a competitividade dos anúncios e a performance global das plataformas. Suas

responsabilidades incluirão:

  • Realizar pesquisa de mercado e análise de ranqueamento e ofertas;
  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de vendas, conversão, buybox e rentabilidade;
  • Criar, corrigir e otimizar anúncios (mídia kit, descrição e ficha-técnica, palavras-chave, precificação);
  • Criar, atualizar e manter cadastros de produtos (SKU, EAN, Bling, FULL etc.)
  • Apresentar e executar plano de ação para alavancar vendas e maximizar lucro;
  • Elaborar relatórios semanais com resultados, ações executadas e próximos passos;

title: Gerente de Marketing
description:
About the Brand We're a bold beauty brand redefining service, fun and results. With our unique DNA and iconic products, we create experiences that go beyond makeup — connecting people, services, and storytelling in every touchpoint.


Role Summary The Marketing Manager 360° sits at the intersection of all cross-functional teams driving the brand and product marketing strategy forward in Brazil. This person blends strategic thinking and creative execution, ensuring the brand remains innovative, disruptive, and locally relevant. You'll bring global campaigns to life in a uniquely Brazilian way, with a consumer-first mindset, a sharp eye for detail, and a passion for brand storytelling and results.


Key Responsibilities


Integrated / 360° Marketing Strategy

  • Develop and execute the full 360° marketing strategy for Brazil, aligned with LATAM and global direction.
  • Bring to life the brand DNA through impactful and locally relevant campaigns, ensuring consistency across all touchpoints.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (creative, digital, retail, PR, influencer, trade, and education) to deliver cohesive brand experiences.
  • Adapt global campaigns and craft localized initiatives based on strategic insights and consumer behavior.
  • Define KPIs and monitor performance to ensure ROI and continuous optimization.
  • Manage marketing budget efficiently and align investments with business priorities.


Brand Activations, Events & Partnerships

  • Ideate and lead brand activations, pop-ups, and in-store experiences that amplify engagement and conversion.
  • Collaborate with influencer and PR teams to develop creative and culturally relevant events, trips, and product send-outs that generate strong EMV and social buzz.
  • Build and manage brand partnerships that expand audience reach while maintaining aspirational image and consistency. This includes experience with negotiating partnership agreements.
  • Oversee the brand's visual merchandising expression across retail doors, ensuring high-quality, on-brand execution.
  • Partner with the Retail & Education teams to boost service awareness and service sales across stores.
  • Coordinate GWP programs, launch activations, and local communication campaigns with a consumer-centric mindset.
  • The ability to analyze ROI for each activation will be key to ensure the spend had a positive impact on retail sales.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

  • Serve as the local bridge between global brand strategy and field execution.
  • Ensure flawless implementation across channels (in-store, online, influencer, social).
  • Lead project timelines, agency briefings, creative reviews, and post-campaign analysis.
  • Partner with Operations, Supply, and Trade Marketing to secure on-time delivery and smooth rollout.
  • Ensure effective communication and collaboration with sales and finance teams to align objectives and maximize results.
  • Report regularly to management on marketing KPIs, results, and insights.


Who You Are

  • 5–10 years of experience in Marketing or Brand Management within beauty, FMCG, or lifestyle industries.
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian retail landscape and consumer behavior.
  • Creative and strategic thinker, with a proven ability to innovate within Global brand guidelines and create data-driven digital campaigns that boost brand awareness and sales.
  • Expertise in marketing strategy combined with strong financial acumen, including proven ability to prepare and manage budgets, analyze marketing spend, forecast sales, and develop data-driven strategies aligned with commercial objectives and measurable impact.
  • Excellent project management and multitasking abilities.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills across departments.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and deadline-driven.
  • MANDATORY Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus).
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (especially PowerPoint), Google Workspace, and ideally Asana or Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Passion for beauty, trends, and building emotional consumer connections.
  • Experience working with global brands and adapting marketing strategies to local markets.


Success Metrics

  • Growth in brand awareness and preference above market trend.
  • Increase in service sales and store traffic.
  • Strong ROI on campaigns and activations.
  • Excellent cross-functional alignment and execution quality.
  • Elevated brand perception and consumer engagement.


Why Join Us We're not just selling beauty — we're creating moments of joy, confidence, and connection. If you're a marketer who blends creativity, curiosity, and commercial drive, and you want to make an impact in a dynamic, growing brand — this is your next challenge.

title: SAP Specialist - HCM - SuccessFactors
description:
Job Overview

The SAP/SuccessFactors Specialist will be part of ADM’s Service Delivery Organization , responsible for ensuring high system availability and reliable operations across all ADM systems.

In this role, you will analyze and resolve user tickets, collaborate with internal teams and third-party providers, and ensure timely resolution within defined Operational and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) .

You will also partner with architects, developers, and testers to design and deliver small enhancements aligned with the global template, following approval from the Solution Delivery Organization.


Key Responsibilities


  • Provide deep functional and technical expertise in the respective process area, with solid understanding of key integration points across modules and technical components.
  • Take full ownership of support tickets within your process area; collaborate with integration, development, and external support teams to ensure timely resolution within SLA limits.
  • Maintain integrity of the global and regional templates designed by Solution Delivery teams while resolving incidents.
  • Conduct thorough testing — including regression testing — before final user validation and release.
  • Adhere to ADM IT processes and Service Management standards, ensuring accurate and up-to-date ticket documentation.
  • Design and configure minor system enhancements, following ADM’s configuration and naming standards, and document functional design specifications.
  • Support audit and compliance requests by providing accurate and timely technical inputs.
  • Ensure all activities comply with regulatory, security, and ADM policy requirements .
  • Partner with global process and system experts to identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities in business processes.



Job Requirements


  • Experience in one or more SAP/SuccessFactors modules ; experience with S/4HANA strongly preferred.
  • Functional knowledge in HR processes such as Employee/Personnel Administration, Payroll, Organization Management, Talent, Compensation, Benefits, Time & Attendance, and Learning Management ; experience in HCM or SuccessFactors required.
  • Experience with integration between SAP HCM/SuccessFactors and S/4HANA ; integration with external payroll or learning systems is a strong plus.
  • Understanding of SAP/SuccessFactors localizations supporting global HR deployments.
  • Proven experience in a support analyst role within a medium or large organization.
  • Experience providing 24x7 global support in multicultural, distributed teams.
  • Previous experience leading a team of support analysts is highly preferred.
  • Exposure to full lifecycle SAP implementations and agile methodologies is an advantage.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with ability to convey complex information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic, and global environment , managing changing priorities with flexibility and professionalism.
  • Strong collaboration, conflict resolution, and problem-solving skills.
  • Willingness to work occasional weekends, holidays, or different shifts as required to meet SLA commitments.
  • Availability to travel occasionally (domestic and international).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, or a related field.
  • Fluency in English is mandatory; Spanish is desirable

title: Network & Security Operations Analyst
description:
Responsibilities：

1. Design, implement, and manage network segmentation between IT and OT domains, ensuring compliance with zero-trust and defense-in-depth principles.

2. Configure and maintain high-availability firewalls, redundant paths, and routing failover policies across data centers and remote sites.

3. Lead root-cause analysis (RCA) for major network or or security incidents and produce corrective-action plans.

4. Develop and maintain network addressing plans, DHCP scopes, NAT rules, and routing policies to guarantee scalability and consistency.

5. Oversee vulnerability remediation activities and validate the effectiveness of penetration-test mitigation actions.

6. Integrate security device logs into SIEM, coordinate with SOC for event correlation and incident escalation.

7. Perform periodic configuration audits and enforce change-management best practices (RFC approval, rollback validation, and documentation).

8. Define and maintain technical standards for VLAN naming, access control, and monitoring configurations.

9. Mentor junior and mid-level analysts, conducting knowledge-transfer sessions and technical training workshops.

10. Coordinate network readiness activities for plant expansions, data-center upgrades, and cloud integrations.

11. Prepare and present monthly KPI and performance dashboards, highlighting trends in latency, availability, and incident rates.

12. Represent the Network Operations function during internal and external audits, ensuring evidence of compliance with ISO 27001 controls.

13. Participate in policy reviews and contribute to global infrastructure standardization with BYD Global IT.

14. Conduct disaster-recovery testing and validate failover mechanisms to ensure business continuity.


Required Quality：

1. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Networks, Information Security, or Telecommunications.

2. Minimum of 6 years of experience in enterprise network design, administration, or security operations.

3. Advanced knowledge of routing, switching, VPN, and firewall management across multi-vendor environments.

4. Proven experience with segmentation projects separating OT and IT environments.

5. Hands-on expertise with firewalls, IDS/IPS, NAC, and SIEM platforms (Fortinet, Cisco, or Palo Alto).

6. Deep understanding of network availability, latency, and performance metrics (MTTD/MTTR).

7. Proficiency in network troubleshooting using packet-capture and analysis tools (Wireshark, NetFlow).

8. Strong ability to manage incident response, root-cause analysis, and postmortem reporting.

9. Familiarity with ISO 27001, NIST, and LGPD security controls applied to network operations.

10. Fluent English for documentation, reporting, and technical meetings; Mandarin is an advantage.

11. Excellent leadership and mentoring skills to guide junior and mid-level analysts.

12. Certifications preferred: Cisco CCNP, Fortinet NSE6, or equivalent professional-level credentials.

13. Solid understanding of EHS and NR compliance, ensuring safe interventions in critical environments.

14. Strong analytical thinking and ability to standardize processes across multiple sites.

15. Availability for travel and participation in corporate audits and cross-site projects.

title: SAP Functional SD Consultant
description:
ITC Infotech is looking for a SAP SD Consultant to join our team in Brazil.

Work Location: Onsite at Project location.


About Us:

ITC Infotech is a leading global technology services and solutions provider, led by Business and Technology Consulting. ITC Infotech provides business-friendly solutions to help clients succeed and be future-ready, by seamlessly bringing together digital expertise, strong industry speciﬁc alliances and the unique ability to leverage deep domain expertise from ITC Group businesses. We provide technology solutions and services to enterprises across industries such as Banking & Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Consumer Goods, Travel and Hospitality, through a combination of traditional and newer business models, as a long-term sustainable partner.


Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced SAP SD Consultant specializing in Brazilian localization to support configuration, implementation, and compliance within SAP ECC. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in local tax and regulatory requirements, including NF-e and Nota Fiscal processes, and experience integrating SAP SD with other core modules. This role requires fluency in Portuguese and English, hands-on configuration skills, and the ability to adapt to evolving tax and business environments.

Key responsibilities

  • Configuration and implementation:

Design, configure, and implement SAP SD processes in SAP ECC, adapting the global template to meet Brazilian statutory, tax, and regulatory needs.

  • Localization expertise:

Handle Brazil-specific localization, including e-invoicing (NF-e), fiscal documents (nota fiscal), new tax reform changes and CFOP determination.

  • Tax and compliance:

Ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws on sales, including ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, and configure related tax calculations and posting rules.

  • Integration:

Work on integrations between SAP SD and other modules like MM and FI, especially for logistics and tax postings.

  • Technical collaboration:

Partner with ABAP developers to develop and test functional specifications for custom enhancements (RICEFW).

  • Project and change management:

Manage multiple work assignments, support project rollout phases, and adapt to new tax laws and regulations.

  • Support:

Provide cutover and hypercare support after go-live.


Required skills and experience

  • SAP experience: 8-10 years of experience in SAP SD, with a focus on Brazilian localization.
  • Localization knowledge: Deep knowledge of Brazilian SAP localization, including e-transformation and e-document requirements.
  • System knowledge: Experience in SAP ECC implementation and deployment projects is a plus.
  • Functional knowledge: Familiarity with other modules like MM and FI is beneficial.
  • Language proficiency: Fluency in both Portuguese and English is often required.
  • Communication: Strong analytical, problem-solving, verbal, and written communication skills.

All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. Competências da SIG


Estamos procurando por pessoas que estejam buscando alcançar resultados de forma consistente, mesmo sob circunstâncias difíceis. Colaboradores que consigam criar um ambiente em que todos sejam motivados a dar o seu melhor a fim de que a organização alcance seus objetivos. Se você está sempre buscando novas maneiras de crescer e enfrentar desafios, se trabalha no desenvolvimento de pessoas capazes de conquistar suas metas profissionais além das metas da organização, a SIG tem um lugar para você. Para entregar o melhor aos nossos clientes, nossos colegas constroem uma forte relação com eles e trabalham para apresentar as soluções de que eles precisam. Por fim, estamos buscando pessoas que sejam capazes de construir parcerias e trabalhar de maneira colaborativa rumo ao alcance dos objetivos comuns. Você é alguém que aplica conhecimento de negócios e mercado para promover os objetivos da organização? Você é alguém capaz de criar novas e melhores maneiras de a organização ter sucesso? Se a resposta é “sim”, venha e junte-se a nós.


Nosso Compromisso


A SIG é o lugar onde você pode construir algo incrível. Nós oferecemos uma remuneração competitiva e a oportunidade de trabalho remoto em regime parcial. Caso se junte a nós, você fará parte de uma organização internacional de sucesso global: a líder do segmento em sustentabilidade, tecnologia e inovação. Nós nos enxergamos como uma pista de decolagem de uma carreira; um lugar de rápido desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional, com trabalho, experiências e oportunidades reais de se adquirir novas habilidades. Você fará parte de uma equipe altamente motivada e dinâmica, e terá oportunidades de desenvolvimento pessoal, além de capacitação e orientação profissional junto de colegas de equipe experientes. Se você mostrar que é capaz e tem vontade de aprender, nós lhe daremos todo o apoio.


Sobre a SIG


A SIG é líder em sistemas de embalagens e soluções. Trabalhamos em parceria com nossos clientes para levar alimentos aos consumidores de todo o mundo de forma segura, sustentável e acessível. Somos o único fornecedor de um sistema de embalagens que trabalha com embalagens cartonadas e dos tipos pouches e bag-in-box. Nossa tecnologia versátil e nossas habilidades em inovação de produto nos permitem entregar o melhor para nossos clientes, nossos consumidores e para o mundo. A sustentabilidade nos guia, a tecnologia nos capacita, mas é a paixão e a motivação de nossa gente que realmente nos inspira a entregar o melhor.

Fundada em 1853, a SIG possui sua sede em Neuhausen, na Suíça, e está listada na Bolsa de Valores SIX Swiss Exchange.

title: Lead Data Platform Architect
description:
Lead Data Platform Architect


Mars is a family-owned business with more than $50 billion in global sales. We produce some of the world’s best-loved brands: M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, MILKY WAY®, DOVE®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, WHISKAS®, EXTRA®, ORBIT®, 5™, SKITTLES®, BEN’S ORIGINAL®, and COCOAVIA®. Alongside our consumer brands, we proudly take care of half of the world’s pets through our nutrition, health and services businesses such as Banfield Pet Hospitals™, BluePearl®, Linnaeus, AniCura, VCA™ and Pet Partners™. Headquartered in McLean, VA, Mars operates in more than 80 countries. The Mars Five Principles – Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom – inspire our 160,000 Diverse Associates to act daily towards creating the world we want tomorrow.


The Lead Data Platform Architect is instrumental in delivering scalable, repeatable and agile data and platform architectures to unlock and drive business value across Finance, Commercial, R&D, MGS Labs and Innovation:


As the Lead Data Platform Architect in the Enterprise Data & Platform team, your key responsibilities are as follows:


TECHNICAL PROFICIENCY AND LEADERSHIP

  • Lead the definition and execution of data architecture strategies across multiple business domains and data platforms.
  • Drive the development of scalable, integrated data models and architectures across raw, trusted, and harmonized zones.
  • Define and execute the data product strategy for assigned business areas in collaboration with analytics and business teams.
  • Act as a thought leader and trusted advisor, supporting teams in understanding business objectives, data requirements, processes, and enabling technologies.
  • Ensure all data architecture efforts are aligned with the broader business vision and strategic priorities and provide architectural oversight across delivery initiatives.
  • Collaborate with other data architects to ensure consistent and integrated use of data assets across the organization.
  • Identify cross-segment and cross-function data dependencies or issues and lead resolution efforts.
  • Provide strategic guidance on data domains, process analysis, data analysis, and modelling techniques.
  • Mentor and coach solution / data architects and engineers to build internal data architecture capability.
  • Advocate for best practices, tools, and methods related to data architecture.
  • Ensure understanding and compliance of data protection policies, security policies, and GDPR


DELIVERABLE INVOLVEMENT & OWNERSHIP

  • Reference Architectures: Own and maintain reusable architectural patterns
  • High-Level Designs (HLDs): Review and approve HLDs from Solution Architects and 3rd parties
  • Key Design Decisions (KDDs): Own and govern major architectural decisions for alignment with the Architecture Review Board and beyond
  • Architecture Option Assessments: Lead decisioning on tooling, modelling, and patterns


DATA & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE OWNERSHIP

  • Develop and maintain current and future state data architectures, models, and roadmaps.
  • Promote awareness and understanding of data architectures across the organization.
  • Review and validate high-level models and reference architecture libraries
  • Approve changes to shared or enterprise-wide data models


Knowledge and Experience


ESSENTIAL:

  • Previous experience as a Senior Data or Platform Architect essential
  • Proven experience as a senior data or platform architect, or similar leadership role in data & platform strategy.
  • Strong background in data modelling, architecture frameworks, and modern data integration methods.
  • Deep understanding of cloud-based data platforms (Azure) and tools (Databricks, SQL, ADF etc) as well as analytics solutions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and align across business and technology functions.
  • Experience building and evolving data & platform architectures that scale and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Passion for coaching and enabling others with a collaborative leadership approach.
  • Knowledgeable in Data Source systems (eg. SAP) and Data Lake technology
  • Stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Fluent in writing and speaking English


DESIRED:

  • Previous experience in CPG industry would be ideal
  • Experience at operating in a complex global matrix organisation
  • Experience at collaborating with cross-functional partners
  • High drive for results and an ability to work with minimum input


What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry-competitive salary and benefits package, including a company bonus.


Mars is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.

title: CargoGoogle Ads Specialist - Lead Generation Focus
description:
What We Offer 


Work From Anywhere – 100% remote opportunity with a results-driven global team.

Proven System For Success – No more hitting and hoping. Our battle-tested Google Ads system generates high-quality leads with consistency so you can focus on precision execution and campaign optimization.

Career Development Opportunities – For high performers, there is opportunity to grow into system-building and high-level strategy roles over time.

High-Impact Role – See your work drive results with granular execution and proactive communication.

Elite Team Culture – Join a group of specialists who prioritize precision, data, and high performance.

Paid Time Off As Needed – Take well-deserved breaks whenever you need them.

Who We Are 


Pressure Washing Marketing Pros is a digital marketing agency focused on Google Ads, SEO, and high-converting web design for exterior cleaning companies. By focusing on this niche, we’ve discovered and scaled on repeatable processes that allow us to:


Execute based on data and beat “seat of the pants” traditional strategies.

Deliver predictable, high-quality leads with our proven Google Ads system.

Scale results by constantly testing, refining, and optimizing our paid campaigns.

Our speed, output, and constant improvement help set us apart from our competition.

Your Role & Impact 


As a Google Ads Specialist on our team, you’ll execute and optimize campaigns across 70+ Google Ads accounts and 25+ Local Service Ads accounts. You’ll join our existing Google Ads Manager and Google Ads Specialist who have been with the company for years and who are experts with our system. You and the current Specialist will follow our framework, while proactively collaborating with our SEO and client success teams to ensure campaigns are always in-line with overall business goals.


Key Responsibilities 


Build campaigns in Google Ads Manager and Ads Editor following our templates and SOPs.

Perform weekly and monthly optimization routines (negative keywords, search term reviews, budgets, ad assets, keyword additions, bidding strategy, etc. ). 

Run through QA checklist before launching or editing a campaign (geo settings, match types, naming conventions, conversion actions, etc. ). 

Maintain documentation and task updates in ClickUp. 

Implement and QA tracking with WhatConverts following established processes.

Run reports in Looker Studio with performance analysis.

Manage Local Service Ads (budget pacing, category, verification checks, etc. ). 

Proactively collaborate with SEO and client success managers to align campaign performance with business goals.

Identify areas of improvement to our SOPs based on test results or recurring events.

What You’ll Need to Succeed 


Minimum of 2 years experience managing Google Ads campaigns for lead generation (non-ecommerce).

Track record of precision execution and zero critical errors in recent work.

Great analytical skillset for search term review, budget pacing, and campaign adjustments.

Familiar with Google Ads Manager, Google Ads Editor, GA4, GTM, Looker Studio, ClickUp, and Slack.

Focus on detail, with ability to follow SOPs 100% and identify opportunities for SOP refinement.

Excellent written English for writing ads, documentation, and communicating with cross-functional teams.

Self-motivated and results-oriented, with strong personal standards for flawless execution.

Bonus Experience (not required): 


Experience with Local Service Ads management 

Unbounce 

Experience optimizing paid campaigns for service-based lead generation

Experience with WhatConverts or CallRail 

What We Value  


Data-Driven Execution – Campaigns are backed by analytics, SOPs, and real-time data.

Ownership & Accountability – We don’t micromanage. We hire A-players who take pride in precision and results.

Proactive Communication – Solutions-oriented communication that is clear and timely across departments and time zones.

Fast-Paced Execution – Weekly optimizations and QA routines are non-negotiable.

Continuous Improvement – We are always refining our systems to push performance higher.

Success Metrics 


Zero critical errors found in QA across all campaigns.

100% of weekly optimization routines completed on time.

Campaign pacing within ±5% of budget plan. 

Negative keyword coverage improves irrelevant query share quarter-over-quarter.

Reporting completeness rate 95%+ as measured by manager audit.

Compensation, Benefits, and Schedule 


Base Salary: $1,200–$2,000 USD/month depending on experience and skill level.

Schedule: Flexible work hours but must be available for mandatory 4-hour team overlap for collaboration with cross-department teams.

Multi-Step Hiring Process 


We’re serious about hiring because we’re serious about building a team of disciplined executors who thrive in a high-performance culture.


The hiring process:  


Application and screening questions. 

Paid trial project with strict QA rubric. 

Final interview and debrief with the manager and CEO.

title: Software Engineer
description:
We are actively seeking a highly skilled and experienced Propulsion Integration engineer to join our dynamic team.


Responsibilities:

  • Work with controls development team, motor controls team and foundation software team and receive the inputs for SW integration for electrified PT vehicles.
  • Perform SW development, code generation, integration, build and execution of test plans, verification and integration of the BPCM/Power Invertor Module (PIM/MGU/EVCU) with vehicle controllers.
  • Perform Control Software development – Implement and test process function for DIDs/PIDs, IO controls & Routines for End of Line testing at plant.
  • Perform Hybrid Control Processor SW Code Generation and resolve issues with controls team.
  • Integrate new content from four different functional systems/components (BPCM,HCP, MCP, BSW & Supplier) into a final flash ready file.
  • Perform Embedded Controller resource monitoring & analysis: VRAM, CPU Throughput, ROM/Flash memory.
  • Measure network parameters using CANoe/CANalyzer and prepare measurement using ETAS-INCA.
  • Perform test bench flashing using Lauterbach/Trace32 (embedded debugger testing), INCA, CDA and verification.
  • Support the One-Offs and Prototype Builds for quick development and validation of bug fixes during cold-trip/hot-trip/altitude testing.


Requirements:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering or a related Engineering degree from an accredited university Minimum 2 years of engineering experience in software development life cycle for automotive and related industries
  • Minimum 2 years of MATLAB/Simulink experience in code generation using RTW and integration experience with vehicle controllers.
  • Minimum 2 years of ECU software SW development experience with good trouble shooting knowledge of compiler build files and integration.
  • Good cross functional working experience within the organization
  • Excellent communication skills both verbal and written Outstanding problem-solving skills
  • Preferred Qualifications:
  • Masters or advanced degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Software Engineering from an accredited university with 2 or more years of experience with development and testing of powertrain controls in hybrid and/or electric vehicles
  • Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink, m-scripting, Visual Basic Experience with AUTOSAR compliant controller development
  • Experience in standard controls tools; modeling, simulation, development, testing, validation, verification Familiarity with OBD II Familiarity with the CMMI and/or ASPICE software development processes


Join our dynamic team and contribute to the development of revolutionary propulsion systems that power our innovative projects. Apply your exceptional skills, knowledge, and enthusiasm to shape the future of transportation and make a significant impact in the industry.

Ensino superior completo nas áreas de Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas relacionadas.

Experiência de trabalho comprovada como Arquiteto de Soluções ou função similar.

title: IT Security & Compliance Consultant
description:
About you

You are someone who provide security, compliance, and risk oversight and drive the creation of the detailed inventory and classification of installed applications—ensuring the taxonomy defined in the charter is implemented (name, version, publisher, category, description, EOL date, plus owner/team fields for future phases), data is normalized across Systems, and risks are surfaced with clear next steps.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (preferred) or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 5–7+ years of experience in security, compliance, or Software Asset Management (SAM) governance.
  • Hands-on experience with Intune, NinjaOne, and ServiceNow SAM.
  • Strong skills in data normalization, taxonomy design, and software lifecycle/EOL management.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with a keen eye for data quality and governance.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to coordinate across technical and business teams.
  • Ability to document processes, identify risks, and provide structured recommendations.
  • Advanced English proficiency to interact effectively with global stakeholders.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Detailed Inventory Build (Installed Apps): Lead aggregation from multiple sources; reconcile source differences; produce a single authoritative baseline of applications and versions for workstations, mobile devices, and servers.
  • Classification & Taxonomy Execution: Implement the charter’s taxonomy fields (Application name, Version, Publisher, Category, Description, End-of-life date; define placeholders for Primary Business Owner, Technical Owner, Team using the application for future phases). Ensure every discovered app is categorized per the defined category scheme and platform (Win/Mac/iOS/Android/Server).
  • Normalization Rules: Define and apply deduplication and normalization (e.g., normalize publisher strings, collapse installer variants, consolidate minor version drift) so each entry represents a canonical application + version.
  • Quality & Coverage Checks: Establish data-quality gates (required fields populated for scope; minimal “Unknown publisher” entries; alignment of device coverage to endpoints in scope). Maintain an Excluded Items log for anything out-of-scope with rationale.
  • Security/EOL Enrichment: Add security-relevant attributes/workflows (EOL flagging, vulnerable/high-risk categories, privileged tools). Create a practical CVE lookup workflow for later phases; prioritize EOL and obviously risky categories.
  • Validation with Business: Facilitate validation sessions with Managing Directors/Dept Leads to confirm the catalog reflects reality; capture deltas and residual risks.
  • Risk Assessment & Inputs to Roadmap: Document findings (unsupported software, shadow IT indicators, risky categories) and quick wins that feed the implementation roadmap/policies (policy drafting is later-phase).


Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

title: Performance Test Engineer (Java and/or C#)
description:
Project Description:

The developed product is a leading software system in the Energy domain, covering all aspects of Oil & Gas production—from geological exploration to the optimization of ongoing operations. Our technology solution enables geologists and geophysicists to efficiently research, visualize, and interpret large volumes of geological data.


This role requires working on-site in the Bangalore office, collaborating closely with the customer team based in Houston while following Agile principles.


You'll be joining a senior, supportive, and friendly team, committed to delivering high-quality solutions in the industry.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop, execute, and maintain performance test plans, scripts, and scenarios for drilling applications.
  • Analyze system behavior under stress, load, and endurance conditions to identify performance bottlenecks and work with development teams for resolution.
  • Use tools such as LoadRunner, JMeter, or custom scripts to simulate operational environments typical in drilling operations.
  • Collaborate with software architects, developers, and DevOps to optimize throughput, latency, and resource utilization.
  • Monitor key performance indicators (CPU, memory, I/O, network) during test executions using tools like New Relic and correlate results with backend logs and telemetry data.
  • Create performance benchmark baselines and contribute to SLAs definition for system responsiveness and throughput.
  • Support CI/CD pipelines by integrating performance testing into automated workflows (e.g., Jenkins, Azure DevOps).
  • Participate in code and architecture reviews to assess and improve system scalability and resiliency.
  • Generate detailed test reports and provide actionable recommendations to stakeholders.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in performance engineering or testing in enterprise or industrial software.
  • Strong Java and/or C# Core understanding with the ability to debug issues, analyse stacktraces, and perform root cause analysis
  • Proficient in scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) for test automation.
  • Experience with monitoring tools like New Relic, Dynatrace.
  • Solid understanding of network latency, threading/concurrency, memory profiling, and database performance (SQL/NoSQL).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to interpret performance metrics into actionable insights
  • Software development background, ability to modify code


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: SAP Functional SD Consultant
description:
ITC Infotech is looking for a SAP SD Consultant to join our team in Brazil.

Work Location: Onsite at Project location.


About Us:

ITC Infotech is a leading global technology services and solutions provider, led by Business and Technology Consulting. ITC Infotech provides business-friendly solutions to help clients succeed and be future-ready, by seamlessly bringing together digital expertise, strong industry speciﬁc alliances and the unique ability to leverage deep domain expertise from ITC Group businesses. We provide technology solutions and services to enterprises across industries such as Banking & Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Consumer Goods, Travel and Hospitality, through a combination of traditional and newer business models, as a long-term sustainable partner.


Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced SAP SD Consultant specializing in Brazilian localization to support configuration, implementation, and compliance within SAP ECC. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in local tax and regulatory requirements, including NF-e and Nota Fiscal processes, and experience integrating SAP SD with other core modules. This role requires fluency in Portuguese and English, hands-on configuration skills, and the ability to adapt to evolving tax and business environments.

Key responsibilities

  • Configuration and implementation:

Design, configure, and implement SAP SD processes in SAP ECC, adapting the global template to meet Brazilian statutory, tax, and regulatory needs.

  • Localization expertise:

Handle Brazil-specific localization, including e-invoicing (NF-e), fiscal documents (nota fiscal), new tax reform changes and CFOP determination.

  • Tax and compliance:

Ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws on sales, including ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, and configure related tax calculations and posting rules.

  • Integration:

Work on integrations between SAP SD and other modules like MM and FI, especially for logistics and tax postings.

  • Technical collaboration:

Partner with ABAP developers to develop and test functional specifications for custom enhancements (RICEFW).

  • Project and change management:

Manage multiple work assignments, support project rollout phases, and adapt to new tax laws and regulations.

  • Support:

Provide cutover and hypercare support after go-live.


Required skills and experience

  • SAP experience: 8-10 years of experience in SAP SD, with a focus on Brazilian localization.
  • Localization knowledge: Deep knowledge of Brazilian SAP localization, including e-transformation and e-document requirements.
  • System knowledge: Experience in SAP ECC implementation and deployment projects is a plus.
  • Functional knowledge: Familiarity with other modules like MM and FI is beneficial.
  • Language proficiency: Fluency in both Portuguese and English is often required.
  • Communication: Strong analytical, problem-solving, verbal, and written communication skills.

The developed product is a leading software system in the Energy domain, covering all aspects of Oil & Gas production—from geological exploration to the optimization of ongoing operations. Our technology solution enables geologists and geophysicists to efficiently research, visualize, and interpret large volumes of geological data.


You'll be joining a senior, supportive, and friendly team, committed to delivering high-quality solutions in the industry.


  • Responsibilities:

• Develop, execute, and maintain performance test plans, scripts, and scenarios for drilling applications.

• Analyze system behavior under stress, load, and endurance conditions to identify performance bottlenecks and work with development teams for resolution.

• Use tools such as LoadRunner, JMeter, or custom scripts to simulate operational environments typical in drilling operations.

• Collaborate with software architects, developers, and DevOps to optimize throughput, latency, and resource utilization.

• Monitor key performance indicators (CPU, memory, I/O, network) during test executions using tools like New Relic and correlate results with backend logs and telemetry data.

• Create performance benchmark baselines and contribute to SLAs definition for system responsiveness and throughput.

• Support CI/CD pipelines by integrating performance testing into automated workflows (e.g., Jenkins, Azure DevOps).

• Participate in code and architecture reviews to assess and improve system scalability and resiliency.

• Generate detailed test reports and provide actionable recommendations to stakeholders.


  • Mandatory Skills Description:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

• 3+ years of experience in performance engineering or testing in enterprise or industrial software.

• Strong Java and/or C# Core understanding with the ability to debug issues, analyse stacktraces, and perform root cause analysis

• Proficient in scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) for test automation.

• Experience with monitoring tools like New Relic, Dynatrace.

• Solid understanding of network latency, threading/concurrency, memory profiling, and database performance (SQL/NoSQL).

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to interpret performance metrics into actionable insights

• Software development background, ability to modify code


  • Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

• Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or private data centers supporting oilfield operations.

• Familiarity with oil and gas drilling workflows, real-time data protocols.

• ISTQB or other performance testing certifications.


  • Languages:

English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Business Development & Merchant Service
description:
About Us：

Keeta , the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better, " we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong . With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia , Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.


What You'll Do:

  5. Build efficient communication channels with headquarters, product, operations, and other relevant departments to promptly relay frontline needs and feedback, facilitating smooth resource and information flow.
  6. Analyze service data , regularly summarize pain points and improvement suggestions, and continuously optimize service processes and team performance.
  7. Monitor satisfaction levels of merchants and BD teams, proactively collect feedback, and drive service innovation and optimization.



What We Need From You:

  1. Experience in BD services, customer service, or related team management, with proven ability in team building and leadership .
  2. Strong problem-solving skills , capable of efficiently handling diverse customer needs and unexpected situations.
  3. Excellent communication and cross-department collaboration skills , able to drive resource integration and issue resolution.
  4. Fluent in English and Portuguese (written & spoken), adaptable to an international work environment .
  5. High sense of responsibility and customer-centric mindset , committed to continuously improving service experience.



What Make This Role Exciting:

  1. Engage in Keeta's strategic global expansion initiatives, collaborating with top-tier international teams to explore and penetrate overseas markets.
  2. Build and refine service systems from scratch, experiencing the thrill of innovation and entrepreneurship in a fast-paced environment.
  3. Design end-to-end service processes with a holistic perspective, driving continuous optimization of business and product strategies.
  4. Thrive in a culture of straightforward communication, efficient execution, seamless collaboration, and abundant growth opportunities.

title: Gerente de Field Marketing Sr
description:
Na ADP, somos motivados pelo seu sucesso. Fazemos com que seus talentos e perspectivas únicos se transformem em um todo. Suas ideias para fazer de modo diferente e melhor são bem-vindas. Nós apoiamos seus esforços para realizar, aprender e crescer. Se o sucesso motiva você, você tem a cara da ADP.

Batalhamos para que cada interação seja motivada pelos nossos valores CENTRAIS : Conhecimento e Visão, Integridade é Tudo, Excelência na Prestação de Serviços, Inovação Inspiradora, Cada Pessoa Conta, Orientação a Resultados e Responsabilidade Social.

A ADP é uma empresa global e uma das líderes de mercado em soluções de RH. Recentemente, ganhou o prêmio de uma das Melhores Empresas para se Trabalhar da Great Place to Work.

RESUMO DO CARGO

O Gerente de Field Marketing de Campo Sr é responsável por apoiar o crescimento da receita de vendas em todo a América Latina por meio de um plano de marketing equilibrado, O foco principal será a geração de leads, apoiar ativações de marketing locais e fornecer suporte à gestão de eventos em tempo real (eventos como feiras, almoços e aprendizados, webinars, etc.).

Atuará como consultor de marketing e suporte para os Gerentes e Vice-Presidentes de Vendas da América Latina, garantindo que o plano de marketing apoie os objetivos de negócios do país, bem como os principais impulsionadores de negócios da ESI.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Avaliação de Mercado (cenário competitivo, competência diferenciada, problemas de mercado)
  • Entender o mercado-alvo – por persona, por segmento, por geografia.
  • Identificar as principais estratégias dos concorrentes e garantir que a ADP tenha uma posição atraente e diferenciada no mercado.
  • Criar um plano de marketing alinhado à estratégia central da ESI, bem como às necessidades locais do país.
  • Impulsionar uma campanha de marketing integrada que gere crescimento – alavancando as ferramentas e recursos da ESI e da Global e/ou criando algo do zero que fale diretamente com o mercado-alvo, conforme necessário.
  • Estabelecer parcerias com Vendas, Capacitação e Gestão de País para criar um senso compartilhado de propriedade, um calendário conjunto de atividades e métricas pelas quais medimos o sucesso.
  • Comunicar e educar a equipe de vendas sobre atividades de marketing novas e planejadas, incluindo programas globais, regionais e locais.
  • Desempenhar um papel ativo na comunicação de marketing.
  • Estabelecer parceria com o marketing de produtos regional para desenvolver ferramentas, programas prontos, treinamento e conteúdo para destacar com sucesso os produtos locais no mix de marketing.
  • Estabelecer parceria com a equipe de relações públicas da ESI e com o fornecedor local de RP para apoiar histórias relevantes, cobertura e construção de marca no mercado local.
  • Gerenciar o orçamento alocado para iniciativas de crescimento e direcionar a melhor alocação para o orçamento digital em conjunto e em acordo com o Gerente de Marketing Digital para a América Latina.
  • Prever, mensurar, analisar e relatar o impacto e o ROI dos programas.
  • Avaliar, selecionar e gerenciar fornecedores locais relacionados a eventos físicos/virtuais que contribuam para programas de criação de demanda local.
  • Estabelecer parceria com as equipes de operações de marketing da ADP e os fornecedores da ESI para apoiar os resultados em marketing digital, web (SEM) e eDM, contribuindo com conteúdo e expertise para aprimorar o ROI.
  • Desenvolver e implementar (com vendas) estratégias de contas-alvo para apoiar a venda baseada em contas.
  • Conteúdo de marketing: localize ativos de marketing globais adicionando localização apropriada, desenvolva estudo de caso para clientes de referência, materiais de vendas, ferramentas de vendas.

REQUISITOS

  • Sólida bagagem em Field Marketing
  • Excelente fluência em inglês para negócios.
  • Domínio da língua espanhola desejável, mas não essencial.
  • Vasta experiência em marketing B2B, com histórico comprovado de conquistas significativas de novos negócios. (Experiência em software de RH e folha de pagamento desejável, mas não essencial.)
  • Liderança de Pessoas: Foca em Comunicação Impactante, Construção de Talentos e Construção de Relacionamentos para desenvolver relacionamentos internos e externos necessários para o sucesso

O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana

“Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo nº 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador.”

title: Quality Assurance Tester
description:
Pois é, a evolução chega para tudo. Finalmente.


Somos protagonistas da revolução que o mercado irá passar para liderar o comércio digital de plano de saúde e benefícios no Brasil para pequenas e médias empresas, potencializando as relações de consumo e a experiência do usuário.   • Já ter experiência com GitHub

Soft Skills

  • Resultado: Orientação para alcançar e superar metas estabelecidas, contribuindo ativamente para o crescimento da empresa.
  • Ownership: Assumir a propriedade dos projetos e tarefas atribuídos, indo além do esperado para garantir a excelência.

title: Game Marketing Analyst/Senior Analyst (Graduated from 2022-2025)
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.



Main Responsibility

Drive the performance of marketing campaigns and generate strategic insights to strengthen brand positioning and boost game performance.



Job Description

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support successful game update launches. Assist in creating marketing plans, coordinating promotional activities, and analyzing campaign performance. Propose data-driven improvements.
  • Coordinate brand activations and events to increase game visibility. Support community-driven and media-focused communication efforts.
  • Monitor key performance indicators such as user acquisition, engagement, and conversion. Consolidate reports and deliver actionable insights for strategic decisions.
  • Stay on top of gaming industry trends and community behavior. Identify collaboration opportunities with influencers and content creators.
  • Translate campaign results and findings into clear reports and presentations for stakeholders and leadership.



Our Ideal Candidate

You are a driven and resilient professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and complex challenges. You bring:

  • Passion: A deep enthusiasm for gaming and a fearless curiosity to explore new ideas and territories.
  • Aptitude: A natural ability to quickly learn and master new skills, tools, and methodologies.
  • Drive: Unwavering commitment to overcoming obstacles and pushing boundaries to achieve your goals.



Requirements

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree completed or expected between December 2022 and December 2025 in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Digital Games or other fields
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Able to work in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote)
  • Able to work in a full-time position (8 hours per day)
  • Passionate about games
  • Knowledge in Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace (Word/Docs, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides)



Why Join Us

Join a dynamic team where you will be directly involved in high-impact strategic projects that shape the future of our games and brand. Benefit from personalized mentorship and continuous learning opportunities through close collaboration with our experienced management team. Your creativity and insights will truly matter in an environment that prioritizes your professional growth.

title: Enterprise Architect
description:

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Job Description:


The Enterprise Architect will be centrally responsible for the strategic definition and implementation of enterprise architecture, working from the design and governance of systems to the integration of technological platforms and operational mining processes. Its mission is to translate business objectives into modern, secure and scalable architectures, aligned with international standards and the automation, sustainability and innovation goals.

This professional will work in partnership with the global Enterprise Architect and cross-functional areas (IT, Operations, Engineering, ESG), ensuring that each solution offers efficient integration between on-premises, cloud, and industrial automation environments.


Main Responsibilities

  • Define, document and evolve integrated Enterprise Architecture models (business, applications, data, technology), using frameworks such as TOGAF/ArchiMate and aligning with the strategic demands of mining, sustainability and digital transformation.
  • Act as a technical reference, leading cross-functional teams, promoting the consolidation of solutions between IT, OT and industrial automation, ensuring adherence to global corporate standards.
  • Evaluate and validate new technologies, platforms, services and methods (Cloud, Edge Computing, Digital Twins, IoT, Analytics, Cybersecurity), always considering the best practices in the mineral and natural resources sector.
  • Develop and maintain architectural criteria that prioritize security, regulatory compliance (LGPD, PIPEDA, GDPR), performance, sustainability and operational integration.
  • Prepare detailed documentation (LLD/HLD, reference architectures, guidelines), transferring knowledge and mentoring technical and business teams both locally and internationally.
  • Lead communication between technical, operations, engineering, and global leaders, promoting efficient collaboration and respecting cultural differences.
  • Continuously analyze technological, regulatory and business trends, proposing standards and improvements that position Vale as an international reference in sustainable and digital mining.
  • Participate directly in the supplier selection/merger processes, prioritizing interoperability, innovation and return on investment in critical projects.


Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Proven experience (minimum of 8 years in IT, with at least 5 as an enterprise architect or similar strategic role in Large Enterprise or mining/resources).
  • Deep knowledge of the mineral, energy or industrial sector, preferably previous experience in large global operations
  • Mastery of the main enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF: Practitioner, ArchiMate, Zachman, DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Excellence in the use of cloud technologies (Azure, AWS, GCP) and data platforms, cross-system integration (ERP SAP/Oracle, SCADA, IIoT, Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse).
  • Ability to design hybrid architectures (on-premises, cloud, edge), industrial data integration (sensing, automation, dashboards, analytics).
  • Strong performance in compliance, industrial cybersecurity (OT/IT Convergence), data protection, disaster recovery and business continuity.
  • Experience in multinational/cross-border projects,
  • Fluent English (technical communication, executive meetings, documentation), advanced Portuguese is a strategic differential for integration between teams.

Soft Skills

  • Advanced communication skills, capable of transmitting complex technical concepts to different audiences (executives, engineers, IT, business).
  • Global strategic vision, aligning local and global initiatives with corporate objectives in sustainable mining, innovation and automation.
  • Analytical and solution-oriented thinking, with high ability to navigate complex, multifunctional and multicultural environments.
  • Collaborative leadership – mentoring, consensus building, influence without direct authority, and excellent internal/external networking skills.
  • Management of priorities, organization and resilience in the face of multiple parallel projects and ad-hoc demands.

Absolute focus on results, delivering tangible value for operation, innovation and sustainability.
